items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I got to know Bob Preston when I was with Peggy.

ctx.x: Saw him the other night. He came over and sat down at the table. I don't know what happened to him. All of a sudden I had to go to work, and that's the last I saw of him. Dick Libertini. He went to Hollywood. He scored, made three or four or five pictures. I don't know what he's doing now. He said he was back here doing some picture or something like that.
I got to know Bob Preston when I was with Peggy. He was going with her.
But the guy that I really like that I worked with was Mitchum. We did a calypso album, and we rehearsed for about
